title.narrative: Resilient Journalism in the Digital Age

description.narrative: The main outcome of the current project is to strengthen media institutions in Morocco including women and men journalists, media workers and youth to be more resilient in the face of online disinformation as well as digital threats and harassments especially in the context of the emergent of artificial intelligence as to be able to contribute positively towards a healthy democratic society. In order to archive this outcome, the project focuses on two main outputs namely (1) Women and men journalists as well as youth in Morocco have increased competency in media and information literacy and artificial intelligence including on countering disinformation and misinformation and (2) Women and men journalists and newsrooms in Morocco have strengthened resilience against threats and online harassments. These two outputs will be articulated through eight activities including assessments; training journalists and youth on media and information literacy and artificial intelligence including on countering online disinformation and misinformation; training journalists, editors, and human rights defenders on how to prepare for and respond to threats and online harassment; trainings of trainers; organising youth camps; and advocating for safety protocols in newsrooms. These actions would benefit at least 550 Moroccan women and men journalists and youths as well as adding at least 30 additional trainers trained and at least 10 newsrooms that have taken steps to incorporate safety protocols to the institutions.
